messages.subject: including .js script on condition
parts:
Hi, my goal here is to include a javascript file on condition, for example upon a click of the button with the use of renderUI/uiOutput.

However, I have been unable to do that via a

output$js <- renderUI({ includeHTML("script.js")})  # in the server.R

and a

uiOutput("js") # in the ui.R

So my attempted workaround right now is to call that script via a combination of:

output$js <- renderUI({ HTML(<script type='text/javascript' src='script.js'></script>) })

and

htmlOutput("js") # in the ui.R

But the script.js does not seem to get called... however this "workaround" with the renderUI/htmlOutput combo works when I do it with an <img> tag.. just not with a <script> tag. Anyone have any thoughts on this? Or perhaps there is another way to do it that I am just missing?

Thanks much!
